prompt:
A minimalist recipe card illustration for South African rooibos tea. Flat-lay top-down view of a single hand-thrown ceramic mug filled with deep ember-red rooibos tea, placed slightly off-center (upper left). Scattered around the mug on a bone #F7EFE2 surface: a small pile of dried rooibos needles (rust-red and ochre fibers), one fresh red rooibos sprig with thin needle-like leaves, and a small wedge of orange peel. The composition breathes — at least half the image is clean empty bone-colored surface. No utensils, no saucers, no text, no steam.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern illustration — flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradients. Rooibos fibers and needle leaves have confident, slightly textural silhouettes, NOT painterly. NO watercolor bleeds, NO paper grain, NO sketchy lines. The mug has a subtle ember glazed rim. Warm late-afternoon light from upper left casts a faint shadow below the mug. Feels rooted, earthy, sun-baked. Recipe card thumbnail — subject must read at small sizes.
